claim: rate_resolution_pkg agrees with tt-npe's interpolateBW to within the twin's own stated quantisation, and the residual is fully explained
completes: the third of the three directly-callable cores

oracle.calls: THEIR interpolateBW(), driven with THEIR BlackholeDeviceModel getTransferBandwidthTable() and getMaxNoCTransferBandwidth()
oracle.harness_does_itself: ONLY the bracket lookup (which two table entries surround the packet size) so the twin can be handed the same pair. The bandwidth VALUE is entirely theirs.

twin.composition: Interpolate_Rate (table bracket) -> Steady_State_Weight (n) -> Blend_Rates (max_bw, steady, weight)

the_residual_is_EXPLAINED_not_tolerated.hypothesis: the dominant error term is the twin's Weight type, quantised to thousandths; a weight error of up to 1/1000 scales by max_bw (60.9 bytes/cycle = 60900 milli), giving up to ~61 milli
the_residual_is_EXPLAINED_not_tolerated.test: every row checked against bound = max_bw_milli/1000 + 2 milli
the_residual_is_EXPLAINED_not_tolerated.consequence: this is a DESIGN consequence of a choice the seat made (Weight in thousandths), not float noise. Widening Weight to parts-per-million would shrink it proportionally.

excluded_by_design.reason: their table's first entry is (size 0, bw 0.0). The twin's Milli_Rate is bounded BELOW BY 1 deliberately - that positivity is what makes the division obligation discharge by construction. Packet sizes bracketed by that zero entry are outside the twin's domain by design, not by accident.
excluded_by_design.honesty_note: these 2 rows are excluded and counted, not silently dropped

mutation_check.why: a differential reporting agreement is worthless unless it can report disagreement
mutation_check.mutation: +60 milli on the twin result, just above the observed honest max of 43

what_this_does_NOT_establish: packet sizes outside their table's range (their fallback path was not exercised)
the derating chain (Apply_Derate, To_Whole_Bytes, Cap_By_Injection) - not driven here
anything about tt-npe's correctness; this is agreement, not correctness
